_doc: Linux (`platform: linux`) entries for libscenesystem.so of build 2000930 (the build the Windows
scenesystem.dll in the database is, ClientVersion 2000930). The module exports no `_ZTV` symbol for
its own classes, so each vtable is located by the one function that stores its address point
(a constructor): a sig ending in `lea rax,[rip+vtable]` and a `rip` step, the way libtier0.json's
CTestScriptMgr is. The VTLEN_* consts are the `vtlen` scan of those tables; sdkcheck.py compares them
with the Itanium vtable lengths of the generated IR (LINUX_VT_PAIRS, rule `==`).
CSceneSystem is not here: its Itanium table carries the entries GCC adds for the overrides of three
secondary bases and its destructors, so no `==` claim about ISceneSystem's 198 slots can be made.
Nothing here has a `bridge` macro: the bridge gate covers the Windows entries only.

CSceneUtils.via: libscenesystem.so 0x38a290: a function that begins with push rbp, lea rax,[rip+vtable] (the CSceneUtils vtable address point; it stores the vtable pointer, i.e. a constructor). No `_ZTV` symbol is exported for the class
CSceneUtils.notes: ISceneUtils implementation (the SceneUtils_001 interface), single table, offset-to-top 0, no destructor entries; the Windows build's table has the same 62 entries (s2sdk-types RE3 section 4)

VTLEN_CSceneUtils.via: libscenesystem.so address point 0xA1F638: 62 .text slot pointers up to the next table's header
VTLEN_CSceneUtils.notes: Itanium length of ISceneUtils' implementation, compared by sdkcheck.py with upstream's Itanium vtable length of ISceneUtils (62)

CRenderingPipelineAlias.notes: IRenderingPipeline implementation that forwards every slot but one to the aliased pipeline, single table, offset-to-top 0; the Windows build's table has the same 14 entries (s2sdk-types RE3 section 4)

VTLEN_CRenderingPipelineAlias.notes: Itanium length of IRenderingPipeline's implementation, compared by sdkcheck.py with upstream's Itanium vtable length of IRenderingPipeline (14)

CSceneView.notes: ISceneView implementation, single table, offset-to-top 0; the Itanium table has 113 entries where the Windows one has 112 because ISceneView's inline destructor takes two slots (s2sdk-types RE3 section 4)
